topic: Earth's Climate: Windward, Leeward, Breezes, and Ocean Currents
key_concepts: Windward mountain slopes receive more precipitation
Leeward mountain slopes receive less precipitation
Rising air cools and water vapor condenses
Descending leeward air warms and dries
A rain shadow dry region forms on the leeward side
Sea breeze occurs during the day due to faster land heating
Land breeze occurs at night due to faster land cooling
Northern Hemisphere ocean currents flow clockwise
Southern Hemisphere ocean currents flow counterclockwise
Warm currents originate near the equator and cold currents near the poles
Cold currents cool adjacent continental coastlines
